notes.final_goal.png: The scene unfolds at night under a deep ultramarine sky with a luminous full moon near the top right, casting cool silver over snow-dusted rooftops and a frozen river. In the lower third, a vintage convertible, its brown leather seats dusted with snow, carries a figure in red scarf, viewed from behind, driving along a wet, lamplit street lined with snow-laden trees and warm amber streetlamps. Across the river, a stone bridge glows beneath golden lights, leading to a skyline where Stalinist spires and modern glass towers rise in contrasting silhouettes—crimson towers centre-left, sleek blue-and-gold skyscrapers top right—while mist curls softly over the water’s surface.
notes.01-moonlit-sky.png: The element image is the full sky visible in the goal, occupying the entire upper half from top edge to the horizon line, centered above the cityscape. It shows a deep ultramarine night sky with swirling, textured clouds in cerulean and lavender, softly lit from behind by a luminous full moon glowing pale yellow-white near the top right. Delicate streaks of falling snow, rendered as tiny white dashes, drift diagonally across the frame. The clouds’ edges are softly feathered, catching moonlight along their undersides, creating a moody, atmospheric glow that contrasts with the warm amber city lights below.
notes.02-historic-buildings.png: The element shows the warm amber-lit historic architecture on the left, featuring an ornate streetside facade with snow-dusted gables and a towering Stalinist skyscraper crowned with a golden spire, its stepped wings glowing against a deep ultramarine sky. In the goal image, this cluster sits in the upper left quadrant, forming the backdrop behind the river and bridge, its golden lights contrasting with the cooler modern skyline to the right. The textures are crisp—snow on ledges, glowing windows, and the spire’s sharp silhouette—anchoring the scene’s nostalgic warmth.
notes.03-domed-church.png: The element image shows a small, isolated Russian Orthodox church with three onion domes—two gold, one dark blue—topped with golden crosses, its pale cream masonry glowing under warm amber uplighting against a deep ultramarine night sky; snow blankets its roof and surrounding shrubs. In the goal image, this church appears on the left, nestled beneath the tall golden skyscraper, occupying the upper-left quadrant, its domes and crosses visible just below the skyline, rendered smaller and integrated into the broader cityscape, its warm lights contrasting with the cool blues of the winter night.
notes.04-kremlin-towers.png: The element image shows a cluster of red brick Kremlin towers with deep green spires and bright red stars, linked by crenellated walls, all dusted with snow and glowing under warm amber lamplight against a cool deep ultramarine sky; this grouping appears in the middle distance of the goal image, centered slightly left, forming the historic core behind the riverbank and bridge, its warm brick and star-lit spires contrasting with the cool blue moonlit sky and modern skyline to the right.
notes.05-modern-skyline.png: The element image shows a cluster of modern skyscrapers against a deep ultramarine night sky, falling snow softening their edges; it occupies the upper right quadrant of the goal image, slightly smaller in scale. Dominating the group is a twisting tower lit in cool white, flanked by curved dark towers glowing with warm amber windows, and a tall angular tower edged in fiery orange. Their glass surfaces reflect the lights with a painterly, textured shimmer. This skyline section is isolated from the historic buildings and river below, preserving its sharp, futuristic silhouette against the moonlit clouds.
notes.06-arched-bridge.png: The element image shows the full side elevation of a low, elegant stone bridge with three rounded arches, isolated against a flat deep ultramarine background. It features warm amber lamplight glowing from ornate black iron lanterns spaced along the snow-dusted balustrade, with tiny dark silhouettes of pedestrians. Snow caps the piers and railings. In the goal image, this bridge appears in the middle distance, spanning the river’s centre, smaller and slightly blurred by atmospheric perspective, its warm lights reflecting softly on the icy water below, framed by the city’s glow and the moonlit sky above.
notes.07-river-reflections.png: The element image is the river’s right half in the goal, occupying the lower third and stretching from centre to right edge; it shows deep ultramarine water with floating white ice patches, broken vertical streaks of warm amber lamplight reflecting off ripples, and soft low mist hovering just above the surface; snowflakes drift across the frame, catching the glow, while the texture is painterly with visible brushwork in the shimmering highlights and frosted edges of ice.
notes.08-snowy-street.png: This element, “Snowy street,” occupies the lower-left quadrant of the goal image, stretching from the bottom edge to the mid-frame, forming the wet, snow-dappled roadway. It features a receding perspective with deep ultramarine sky above, warm amber streetlamp glows reflecting on slick black pavement, and scattered snowflakes catching light. Silhouetted pedestrians line the left sidewalk under snow-laden trees, while distant cars glow with crimson taillights. The scene’s texture is richly painterly—wet asphalt mirrors light, snow clings to railings and tree limbs, and the golden reflections create a luminous path leading toward the bridge.
notes.09-lamps-and-trees.png: In the goal image’s left foreground, the “Lamps and trees” element anchors the scene: a tall, ornate black cast-iron lamp with glowing warm amber glass stands beside a snow-laden, leafless tree, its branches detailed and textured with thick snow. The lamp’s base and canopy wear snow caps, glowing against a deep ultramarine night. The tree’s trunk and limbs catch golden light, contrasting the cool blue background. Though the goal includes distant city lights and a river, this element remains isolated in the lower left, untouched by architecture or figures, preserving its painterly, intimate glow.
notes.10-snowy-railing.png: The snowy railing, rendered in deep iron-black with warm amber highlights from streetlamps, stretches diagonally from the lower right toward the upper left, its ornate curved bars and snow-capped posts catching the golden-blue twilight. It occupies the lower third of the goal image, running alongside the riverbank, its texture crisp with granular snow and glistening ice. The railing’s perspective pulls the eye inward, framing the river and distant cityscape, its silhouette sharp against the cool indigo water and softly glowing architecture beyond.
notes.11-woman-back-view.png: The element is the woman’s back view, centered in the lower third of the goal image, seated in a vintage convertible. Her brown hair, in a low twisted bun, catches warm amber rim light against a deep ultramarine night sky. A chunky, crimson-red knitted scarf wraps her neck, contrasting with the dark, snow-dusted fur coat shoulders. Her gloved hands rest near the steering wheel. The texture of the scarf and fur is richly rendered, with snowflakes clinging to every surface, and the light accentuates the silhouette’s curves and edges without revealing the car or background.
notes.12-vintage-convertible.png: The element is the vintage convertible, positioned in the lower third of the goal image, viewed from behind and slightly above, filling the foreground. It shows a deep burgundy body with snow-dusted curves, a curved windshield catching warm amber reflections, a central rearview mirror, and a left round side mirror. The wooden dashboard and analog gauges are visible behind the steering wheel. The paint’s rich, reflective surface gleams under streetlights, contrasting with the cool, snowy textures and the city’s deep ultramarine night sky above.
